name: Trae
summary: ByteDance's AI coding environment (TraeCode) and work assistant (TraeWork).
description: Trae is a set of AI tools from ByteDance. TraeCode is a coding environment with an AI agent that writes and edits code, and TraeWork is a general work assistant available on desktop and the web. Lite, Pro and Pro+ paid tiers are listed on the plans page. A free version can be downloaded.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Free at 0 €. Pro 18 €/month with included usage, Pro+ 54 €/month and Ultra 181 €/month (the previous Lite tier was no longer listed).

howToUse.title: Open Trae
howToUse.description: Open Trae, the ByteDance tools. TraeCode and TraeWork can be downloaded, including a free version.

howToUse.title: Write code in TraeCode
howToUse.description: In the TraeCode coding environment, the agent writes new code and edits files you already have.

howToUse.title: Use TraeWork
howToUse.description: Open TraeWork on the desktop or on the web and use it as a general work assistant.

howToUse.title: Compare Lite, Pro, and Pro+
howToUse.description: On the plans page, compare Lite, Pro and Pro+ tiers and choose the one that fits your usage.
